data.name: DPX Electronics Case
data.teaser: Adds a custom electronics storage case for SPT 4.0.13, sold by Skier LL1.
data.description:
DPX Electronics Case

Adds a dedicated electronics storage case to SPT.

The DPX Electronics Case is designed for players who want a cleaner stash without mixing CPUs, RAM sticks, SSDs, circuit boards, military electronics and tech loot into a general junk box.

Features

  • New custom container: DPX Electronics Case
  • Sold by Skier LL1
  • Price: 500,000₽
  • External size: 3x3
  • Internal storage: 10x10
  • Custom graphite / PCB-style texture
  • Strict electronics whitelist
  • No BepInEx plugin required
  • Does not modify SPT_Data

Accepted item types

The case is made for electronic and tech items, including:

  • CPU
  • CPU Fan
  • RAM
  • SSD
  • HDD
  • Powerbank
  • Printed Circuit Board
  • Military Circuit Board
  • Military Cable
  • VPX
  • Virtex
  • RFID Reader
  • COFDM
  • Microcontroller Board

Installation

Extract the ZIP into your SPT root folder.

Expected structure:

SPT/ user/ mods/ DPX-ElectronicsCase/
data.custom_ai_disclosure: AI was used as an assistant during development to help generate code, debug SPT compatibility issues, create documentation text, and design visual assets such as the thumbnail and custom case texture. The final mod was tested manually in-game before release.

versions.description:
DPX Electronics Case v1.1.0

Changes

* Added `config/config.json`.
* Added configurable external case size.
* Added configurable internal grid size.
* Added configurable price.
* Added configurable trader and loyalty level.
* Added configurable accepted categories and accepted items.
* Kept the full Electronics category as the default filter.
* Icon, model, prefab and bundle are not configurable.

Default Settings

* Trader: Skier
* Loyalty level: 1
* Price: 250000 roubles
* External size: 3x3
* Internal grid: 10x10
* Default filter: Electronics category

Compatibility

* SPT 4.0.13

### Install

1. Download the archive.
2. Extract it.
3. Copy the `SPT` folder over your SPT installation folder.
4. The mod should end up here:

`SPT/user/mods/DPX-ElectronicsCase/`

Important

Avoid reducing the internal grid size after storing items inside the case.

DPX Electronics Case v1.0.1

Changes

* Changed the internal container filter to use the full Electronics category.
* Improved compatibility with modded electronic items.
* The case should now accept vanilla and modded items correctly inheriting from the Electronics category.

Compatibility

* SPT 4.0.13

Install

1. Download the archive.
2. Extract it.
3. Copy the `SPT` folder over your SPT installation folder.
4. The mod should end up here:

`SPT/user/mods/DPX-ElectronicsCase/`

Notes

This update was made thanks to a community suggestion.

Initial release.
